hero.description: For over a decade, AS Events has been transforming dreams into reality, creating luxury experiences that leave lasting impressions.

story.paragraph1: Founded in 2014, AS Events began with a simple vision: to revolutionize the event planning industry by combining creativity, precision, and unparalleled service.
story.paragraph2: What started as a small team of passionate event enthusiasts has grown into one of the most sought-after luxury event management companies.
story.paragraph3: Our journey has been defined by our commitment to exceeding expectations. Every event we create is a testament to our dedication to perfection and our clients' unique visions.

We are committed to delivering personalized, luxury experiences with impeccable attention to detail, innovative concepts, and flawless execution. tips.bookEarly: Book your venue 4-6 months in advance for peak wedding season.
tips.allocateBudget: Allocate 40-50% of budget to venue and catering combined.
tips.confirmVendor: Confirm vendor availability before finalizing your event date.
tips.coordinateWeddingEvents: Plan haldi, mehendi, and sangeet as separate coordinated events.
tips.backupIndoor: Consider a backup indoor space for outdoor ceremonies.
tips.finalizeAV: Finalize AV and branding requirements early with your team.
tips.scheduleWalkthrough: Schedule a venue walkthrough before signing contracts.
